title: ComplianceProbeResult
description: Machine-readable output of pd agent probe (binder ch03). Compliance is daemon-witnessed, never self-attested. THE WITNESSING INVARIANT (ADR-0095 §8, normative — enforced by compliance-invariants.mjs, not expressible in the draft-2020-12 keyword subset): for every ladder level Lk from C1 up to the asserted complianceLevel, (a) some checks[] entry with level==Lk must have daemonWitnessed:true AND passed:true, and (b) some negativeProbes[] entry that targets Lk (a forged-level probe with targetLevel==Lk, or a gateway probe whose targetLevel==Lk) must have present:true and, if fired:true, downgraded:true. witnessedLevel is the daemon-computed highest level meeting (a)+(b) for every level beneath it; complianceLevel MUST NOT exceed witnessedLevel. A probe with complianceLevel>C0 and no such witness chain is self-attested and INVALID. forged-level is the universal per-level witness — instantiate one per non-base level so C1, C3, C5, and C6 are each daemon-witnessable, not only the gateway levels (C0/C2). Ladder frozen to 7 levels C0..C6 (ADR-0095 fork resolution 2).

adapterKind.description: codex-cli, claude-code, cloudflare, ollama, lmstudio, custom-stdio, custom-http.

complianceLevel.description: The effective (granted) level. C0 Registered, C1 Transcripted, C2 Governed, C3 Suggestible, C4 Controllable, C5 Cooperative, C6 Resumable. MUST NOT exceed witnessedLevel (see the witnessing invariant).

witnessedLevel.description: Daemon-computed highest level backed by a positive daemon-witnessed check AND a present (fired->downgraded) targeted negative probe for every level beneath it. Recomputable from checks + negativeProbes by compliance-invariants.mjs. complianceLevel that exceeds this is self-report and invalid.

daemonWitnessed.description: False means self-report; self-reported checks cannot advance a level past C0.

level.description: The level this check gates, when applicable.

negativeProbes.description: Adversarial fixtures that try to forge a level; the daemon must catch them. Every non-base level in witnessedLevel needs at least one targeted probe here. Every fired probe that succeeds at forging must produce downgraded: true.

targetLevel.description: The ladder level this probe attacks. forged-level is parameterized: instantiate one per non-base level so every level is falsifiable. Gateway kinds pin to their gate: forged-heartbeat->C0, direct-mcp-bypass/disabled-hook-after-launch/observed-to-controlled->C2 (the governance gate), forged-guidance->C3 (the suggestibility gate, ADR-0096: an unsigned/invalid-signature GuidanceEnvelope must be rejected — rejection records fired:false; a body that acts on unsigned guidance fires the probe, must record downgraded:true, and cannot advance past C0 on the suggestibility axis).

present.description: A real, daemon-exercised fixture — not stubbed or planned.

downgraded.description: Never assumed true when absent. Required to be true when a fired forge would otherwise succeed.

observedLevel.description: Daemon-computed effective level after the probe. When a fired forge is caught this is below targetLevel — the concrete downgrade evidence v0 previously left undefined.
